timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the configuration was generated

state_etag.description: The `state_etag` of the last _state_ message sent by the device. [Writeback documentation](../docs/specs/sequences/writeback.md)

set_value_expiry.description: An expiry for the the device to revert to baseline (no set value). [Writeback documentation](../docs/specs/sequences/writeback.md)

sample_limit_sec.description: Minimum time between sample updates for the device (including complete and COV updates). Updates more frequent than this should be coalesced into one update.

sample_rate_sec.description: Maximum time between samples for the device to send out a complete update. It can send out updates more frequently than this. Default to 300.

notifs.description: The notifications defined in this dictionary indicate the configured notification targets for the device. [Notifs documentation](../docs/messages/notifs.md)
